text:
I rewrote two parts of the chat-v2 `requirements.md` and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. I didn't shoot any pages or read `text-check.mjs`'s source.

- **Shown, not told:** I added a small tree of the nested chat. A Prompt sits at the root, with the 🧠 replies, questions and task cards beneath it.
- **Checklist:** "Done when" is now a checklist of steps 1–3, the owner-visible result, and the two readmes.

The only `text-check.mjs` flag was `past-work.md` at 816 words. That file is generated by `Server/PastWork.mjs`, so I left it alone.

Chat v2 step 1, the read-only renderer, is built and committed as `5e3ff2a46` on `worktree/chat-v2`. I have not merged it; the parent reviews and merges.

**What's built** (in `public/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`):
- **Renderer:** `ChatV2.js` is `class ChatV2 extends JSONL` and `ChatV2Model.js` folds the lines. Each Prompt draws at the chat root, with no bubble and no card. It shows the refined text, or its sentences when there is no refined text.
- **Nesting:** replies, questions and child tasks sit under their prompt, marked 🧠, in file order with nothing sorted. A root Question with `from` also nests under its prompt.
- **Raw text:** "show raw" reveals the raw Whisper lines and the cleaned paragraphs. It stays open when a live append redraws the chat.
- **Anchored replies:** a reply tied to a sentence and a word range marks those words. It sits beside its sentence when sentences are visible and below it on a phone.
- **Styles, fixture and page:** `ChatV2.css` has every rule in `@layer` with `chat-v2-` classes. `fixture/session.jsonl` is the sample. `page.js` is the demo at `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`, and `?src=` points it at another file.
- **Docs:** `readme.md` is new, with one link line added to `ext/Chat/readme.md`. The old chat is untouched.

**Test:** `ChatV2.test.mjs` passes 19 of 19. It covers order, nesting, the question and task phases, show raw, and live append without a reload. `node --check` passes on every JS file. `node Server/smoke.mjs` shows no FAIL on `/framework/ext/Chat/v2/`.

**Shots:** both are in `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/dictation-debug/chat-v2/renderer/shots/`.
- `chat-v2-1920.png`
- `chat-v2-390.png`

**Decisions:**
- **Plain fold instead of `Session.replay`:** `Item.hydrate` drops the raw Whisper strings, so the model folds the lines itself. `ChatV2Model.js` is the one file to swap when the real `core/Task/Prompt.js` and `Question.js` land.
- **Own child card instead of `TaskView.row`:** the card carries the phase data the test checks. It reuses `TaskView.STAGE` for task icons.
- **Anchored replies drawn once:** beside the sentence when sentences are visible, otherwise in the nest with a quote chip.

No existing readme or doc is out of date. No skill misled me. Nothing writes this data into a session yet; the readme says so. The logging and finish line are in my `renderer/session.jsonl`.
